# Auralith Update

The Auralith Update expands Essentia Reforged with new progression mechanics and world content.

## This update adds:

- A new world structure featuring a new mob
- A brand-new Upgrade System via the Upgrade Station
- Upgraded tools now grant additional effects
- New crafting recipes to support the system

# Essentia Reforged
Essentia Reforged is a Minecraft mod that expands the mining and combat experience with entirely new and unique content. It adds:

## 📝 What does this mod add?

### Powerful new ores
- Luminarita: stronger than Netherite, used to craft legendary tools, weapons, and armor.
- Prismecice: essential for creating the magical item and building blocks.
  
  
### Special tools and weapons
- Sword, Pickaxe, Shovel, Axe, and a Hammer that breaks blocks in a 4x4 area.
- Custom bow for ranged combat.

  
### Complete armor sets with special bonuses
- Each piece provides protection and unique abilities.
- Full set bonus: increases player speed and grants light regeneration.
  
### Unique magical items
- Recovery Crystal: automatically restores a portion of health when used.
- Orfinder: a device that detects nearby ores to make mining easier.
  
### Why play Essentia Reforged
- Makes mining and crafting more strategic and rewarding.
- Adds unique mechanics that combine exploration, combat, and magic.
- Perfect for players looking for new challenges and powerful rewards.

## 🔍 Why should you try this mod?
- Makes mining more strategic and rewarding.
- Adds depth to combat with full armor set bonuses.
- Introduces new tools and blocks for creative and survival play.
- Perfect for players who enjoy exploring and discovering hidden mechanics.

## 💡 Getting started

- Install Essentia Reforged in your mods folder.
- Compatible with standard Minecraft, no extra mods required for basic features.
- Equip full armor sets to activate bonuses and discover magical items.
